name: Hazuki Hisui
source:
An angel who came to Earth to lay eggs.

Cheerful, not fussy, and good-natured. A hero who is full of curisoity. He's so careless that he always makes Juliel worry.

Hobby: Helping people

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160726161005/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_hisui.html]official website[/url]]
